system.description: A Focus for a relaxed drifter who knows a little about a lot of things.

abilities.name: Joy in Small Things
abilities.description: Regain 4 Intellect points when you learn or figure out something important; later uses before a ten-hour recovery restore one fewer point each time.

abilities.name: Life Lessons
abilities.description: Choose two noncombat skills; when you apply Effort to either, you gain one free level of Effort.

abilities.name: Picking Up the Slack
abilities.description: Fill in for a nearby skilled ally who cannot perform a specific task.

abilities.name: Inspiring Ease
abilities.description: When you and allies share a ten-hour recovery, your stories, songs, or art grant each of you an additional recovery benefit.

abilities.name: Totally Chill
abilities.description: A ten-minute recovery takes one action, and an hour-long recovery takes ten minutes.

abilities.name: Extra Padding
abilities.description: Gain extra protection from physical threats and improve which wounds you can ignore with Effort.

abilities.name: Improvise
abilities.description: When untrained in a task, improvise a tool, insight, or lucky break to gain an asset.

abilities.name: Agile Wit
abilities.description: Spend Intellect points for Speed tasks, or Speed points for Intellect tasks, using the Edge of the Pool spent.

abilities.name: Gather Your Strength
abilities.description: Your attack deals 2 additional damage when made as a Last action.

abilities.name: Attention to Detail
abilities.description: A nonattack task gains an asset when attempted as a Last action.

abilities.name: Drawing on Life's Experiences
abilities.description: Ask the GM one question and receive a general answer whose detail depends on how obscure the knowledge is.
